## Teaching points

1. Reduced reserve makes secondary pneumothorax different from a minimally symptomatic primary pneumothorax.
2. Monitor for worsening respiratory or circulatory compromise; do not wait for imaging if tension is suspected.
3. Discuss an individualized oxygen target; this COPD patient needs controlled oxygen and blood-gas reassessment if oxygen is required.
4. Pleural drainage is a receiving-team plan in this simulation; handing over does not mean the lung has already re-expanded.
